label: disallowed_urls
type: the prefix-matched denylist of URLs the CURL() function may not call, taking precedence over allowed_urls
note: Recurrence 1, promoted under the family exception on the definitional test - see n1ql:curl-all-access, whose definition names this field. Carries the family's precedence rule, which is the fact a reader needs and the one a bare id list would drop: 'If both allowed_urls and disallowed_urls fields are populated, the disallowed_urls field takes precedence over allowed_urls.' Deny-wins, prefix-matched. Sibling: n1ql:curl-allowed-urls; container: n1ql:query-curl-whitelist.
